newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL- Atmel Corp loses on Q2.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL- Atmel Corp loses on Q2.

text.p: Atmel Corp shares lost half a point in after-hours trade on Thursday after the company reported second quarter earnings that were spot on analysts' expectations, traders said.
Atmel reported net income of $27.4 million, or $0.27 per share, for the quarter, compared with 50.3 million, or $0.50 per share, for the same period in 1996.
Dealers said the computer circuit maker traded at 28, below an unofficial close of 28-1/2.
Also trading below its market close after releasing earnings performances was Electronics for Imaging.

The company traded at 52-1/8, down from a closing price of 52-13/16, after posting net income for the second quarter of $22.6 million or $0.41 per share. Electronics for Imaging posted net income of $13.9 million, or $0.25 per share for the year-ago period.
Otherwise stocks did not stray far from their closing prices. "I'm not seeing anything major," a trader said.
MCI Communications was the biggest after-hours mover, dropping to 40 from an unofficial close of 42-3/8.
The telecommunications heavyweight waited until late in the day to say it expected second quarter earnings to be in line with analysts' expectations, despite losses in local services.
Regular-hours trading saw the Dow Jones Industrial average surge 44 points to close at 7887.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume rose to 71,300 from 24,800 the previous day, and session two volume fell to 1,158,400, compared with 3,061,187.
